builtBy: pnpm fetch-club-rosters:basketball (scripts/fetch-club-rosters-passport.mjs): the public boys club team rosters of the Northern California events on The Passport (G365, The Stage, Breakthrough, Strictly Hoops, For the Love of the Game) and of the programs clubs.json has a record for at the adidas 3SSB sessions. clubSlugs is kept by hand and carried over.
notes: A kept copy of the public boys club basketball team rosters on The Passport, so a high school roster can be compared with them (pnpm compare-club-rosters:basketball). Never rendered: it names players who are on no tracked roster.

A Passport roster gives each player's name, positions, height and class year, and no school. A team is read at the latest event it played (its roster as it stood then); the events are listed in leagues[], each with the club season it is for (the spring and summer 2026 events are the 2025-26 club season, the fall events the 2026-27 season).
Kept per player: name, positions, class year. Not kept: jerseys, heights, photos, ids, coaches, and players outside the classes of 2027-2030 (counted in tooYoung). Read 2026-11-27.
